findings.title: Late content is placed in two steps and can flip the bubble's side
findings.evidence: Search route delayed 2.5 s, layout-1 1280x720: rAF-sampled bubble geometry 40/108, one frame 0/149, then 191/432. Typing a filter that matches one-line content ('zzzz') flips the bubble from below the trigger to above it (top 40, 108 px); clearing flips it back. 0 style mutations in 2 s idle, so no loop.
findings.consequence: Cosmetic: a one-frame flash on late content and the bubble jumping across the trigger while a filter narrows the list. R25 unaffected.
findings.minimal_fix: Optional: keep the chosen side while open (choose on open and resize only) and apply the observer's remeasure synchronously (flushSync).

findings.title: Two protections in the fix are not killed by any test
findings.evidence: Removing the in-bubble early return alone: 15/15 Popover tests pass (reposition(false) never measures, so the guard is redundant). Removing the body.scrollTop restore: 15/15 pass in jsdom, but in Chromium scrollTop becomes 0 after resizing a scrolled body (1000 -> 0).
findings.consequence: A refactor could reintroduce a snap-back on resize or content change without a red test.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a test with a scrollTop setter that clamps while inline maxHeight is lifted and assert the offset is restored after a resize event.

findings.title: Bottom viewport margin is not kept when the room below is the limit
findings.evidence: layout-2 1024x768, trigger moved 200 px down: bubble top 358 + height 410 = bottom 768 = viewport height. top = rect.bottom + 8 with maxHeight = vh - rect.bottom - 8. The new test 'keeps the whole bubble inside the viewport' passes only because the 60% cap binds in its fixture.
findings.consequence: A room-limited bubble touches the viewport bottom edge; the dismiss control stays visible, so R25 holds. Behaviour predates the phase but the new comment and test claim a margin.
findings.minimal_fix: Use viewportHeight - rect.bottom - 2 * VIEWPORT_MARGIN for spaceBelow and add a room-limited test fixture.
